description: Na₈Mg(NiO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.65 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.70 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.48 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.85 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.86 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four NiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.54 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four NiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.42 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form NiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.96 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form NiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.93 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-11°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-11°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom.
